They felt they were Spanish and now suddenly they lost everything. Now, a lot did convert, which caused a schism within the Jewish religion—those who converted versus those who refused to convert became bitter enemies.

So what will happen now is that many Jews choose to settle in the Polish Lutheran Commonwealth, a new nation in need of people. They adopt an extremely tolerant policy towards the Jews, allowing them to practice their own religion. As a result, many Jews around the world settle there and thrive.

They do extremely well, but this area can be easily invaded. Wealth attracts invaders from Sweden and Russia, leading to wars and Jewish casualties. When they think they finally found a home, they face persecution again. This history creates a major crisis of faith among Jewish people.

The first law in the Jewish religion is not worshiping false idols—the first commandment. The questions are: Why can Jews convert to Christianity or Islam without suffering consequences? Why do so many Jews convert if Yahweh demands complete obedience? And if Yahweh promised them a homeland, why don't they have it despite all the persecution and trauma?

One man named Zevi, born in the Ottoman Empire, declares himself the Messiah. Zevi is seen as Jesus in the Jewish religion but information about him comes mostly from his enemies—the rabbis. His followers are secretive.

Whenever a messiah comes, he seeks to overthrow social order and asks why Jews are persecuted. His answer: It's because of corrupt rabbinical laws, not faith. The rabbis, like corrupt priests or the Catholic Church, control the Jews and maintain their hierarchy by making unfair agreements with European nobility. Zevi argues for a faith-based religion without hierarchy, where people can freely choose their lifestyle and religion.

Rest on Saturday (Sabbath) doesn't make sense; what matters is your heart's faith in God. We are one family born of Abraham—our shared blood should matter more than external rules.
